name: Husqvarna 450 Rancher
blurb: 50.2 cc ranch saw. Stock 18″ setup: .325″ pitch, .050″ gauge, 72 drive links — Husqvarna H30 / X-CUT SP33G.
intro: The 450 Rancher is a 50.2 cc X-Torq ranch saw, most commonly sold in North America with an 18″ narrow-kerf bar. Its factory chain — Husqvarna H30, now also sold as X-CUT SP33G — is a .325″ pitch, .050″ gauge loop with 72 drive links at 18″, sharpened with a 3/16″ file. An owner's actual bar for this saw, stamped “18″ · .325 · 050 · 72”, is the worked example in our verification guide.

bars.note: Confirmed by Husqvarna's H30 chain data (18″, .325″, .050″, 72 DL) and Husqvarna bar listings for this model. Narrow-kerf chain: pair it with a narrow-kerf (.050″) bar.
Listed for the 435/440/445/450 family in Husqvarna chain fitment listings. If your 450 wears a 16″ bar, expect 66 — then confirm on the stamp.
